request.query: A lower bound for the infimum of weights of a nonempty finite support follows if all observations of smaller weight are zero, testing inside a set and vanishing outside.

items.name: Finset.inf'_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : SemilatticeInf α] {s : Finset β} (f : β → α) {b : β} (h : b ∈ s),
  s.inf' ⋯ f ≤ f b

items.name: Real.le_sInf
items.type: ∀ {s : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ}, (∀ x ∈ s, a ≤ x) → a ≤ 0 → a ≤ sInf s

items.name: Finset.le_inf'
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : SemilatticeInf α] {s : Finset β} (H : s.Nonempty) (f : β → α) {a : α},
  (∀ b ∈ s, a ≤ f b) → a ≤ s.inf' H f

items.name: Finsupp.le_weight_of_ne_zero
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {w : σ → M},
  (∀ (s : σ), 0 ≤ w s) → ∀ {s : σ} {f : σ →₀ ℕ}, f s ≠ 0 → w s ≤ (Finsupp.weight w) f

items.name: le_csInf_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s : Set α} {a : α},
  BddBelow s → s.Nonempty → (a ≤ sInf s ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, a ≤ b)

items.name: Set.Nonempty.csInf_mem
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] {s : Set α}, s.Nonempty → s.Finite → sInf s ∈ s
